https://skillshop.exceedlms.com/student/.language: English on the linked Fundamentals course.
https://skillshop.exceedlms.com/student/.device: A browser for the online modules and interactive questions.
https://skillshop.exceedlms.com/student/.assessmentFee: No separate final exam for Fundamentals. Complete the in-course activities.
https://skillshop.exceedlms.com/student/.award: A digital award on your Skillshop profile after completing every module.

https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/traini.language: English and other languages. Availability varies by module.
https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/traini.device: Use a browser. Individual labs can require extra software or a cloud subscription.
https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/traini.assessmentFee: Module knowledge checks are free. Professional certification exams have separate pricing.
https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/traini.award: Module badges and learning-path trophies in your Learn profile.

https://vodacom.com/digital-skills.php.language: The South Africa entry page is in English. Check the language of the chosen partner course.
https://vodacom.com/digital-skills.php.device: Internet access to a partner learning platform. Check device requirements for any hands-on lab.
https://vodacom.com/digital-skills.php.assessmentFee: Check the assessment terms on the partner course page. The hub lists no common exam fee.
https://vodacom.com/digital-skills.php.award: The partner sets the award. Selected AWS Educate activities offer digital badges.

hp-life-free-business-digital-courses.language: Eight languages including English, Portuguese and French.
hp-life-free-business-digital-courses.device: Computer or mobile device with a supported browser, or the HP LIFE mobile app.
hp-life-free-business-digital-courses.assessmentFee: R0 to complete the course activities and earn the certificate.
hp-life-free-business-digital-courses.award: Free HP LIFE Certificate of Completion.

openlearn-free-learning-statements.language: English options in the catalogue. Check the course description for other languages.
openlearn-free-learning-statements.device: A current browser on a computer or mobile device. Older interactive activities may need another browser.
openlearn-free-learning-statements.assessmentFee: R0, including quizzes on badged courses.
openlearn-free-learning-statements.award: Statement of Participation. Selected courses also award a digital badge.

ibm-skillsbuild-free-learning.language: English and translations depending on the course. Exploring Data, for example, offers eight languages.
ibm-skillsbuild-free-learning.device: Use the web learning portal. Check each hands-on activity for additional tools.
ibm-skillsbuild-free-learning.assessmentFee: Free learning and eligible digital credentials. Check the requirements on the individual credential.
ibm-skillsbuild-free-learning.award: Selected activities award IBM digital credentials to registered learners.

learnfree-practical-skills.language: English lessons are available in the linked library.
learnfree-practical-skills.device: Phone, tablet or computer with an internet browser. A computer is useful for practising office software.
learnfree-practical-skills.assessmentFee: Free tutorials. Check the chosen topic for quizzes or completion requirements.
learnfree-practical-skills.award: A certificate option appears after completion when the course offers one.

stellenbosch-ai-literacy-access.language: The university guide is in English. It does not specify other teaching languages.
stellenbosch-ai-literacy-access.device: Internet access to the online course and a university email account.
stellenbosch-ai-literacy-access.assessmentFee: Course access is free for eligible SU staff and students. SU lists no separate assessment fee.
stellenbosch-ai-literacy-access.award: SU says successful learners receive an official short-course certificate.

creating-hope-ai-november-2026.language: Programme information is in English. The teaching language is unspecified.
creating-hope-ai-november-2026.device: Laptop or computer with internet access and a free account on a supported AI tool.
creating-hope-ai-november-2026.assessmentFee: Ten module assessments form part of the advertised free programme.
creating-hope-ai-november-2026.award: Completion certificate after meeting the pass criteria for the advertised cohort.

wethinkcode-free-ai-training.language: The programme guide is in English. Check language support for your cohort.
wethinkcode-free-ai-training.device: The course runs online. A computer is useful for comparing AI tools and completing practical tasks.
wethinkcode-free-ai-training.assessmentFee: The provider describes the course and its practical activities as free.

sap-learning-hub-student-edition.language: Check the selected learning journey and certification exam for language options.
sap-learning-hub-student-edition.device: Use a computer for SAP practice systems. Check the technical requirements for your chosen exam.
sap-learning-hub-student-edition.assessmentFee: Two SAP certification exam attempts are included during the eligible student subscription.
sap-learning-hub-student-edition.award: SAP Certification if you pass its exam. Practice-system access alone does not earn it.

aws-educate-free-cloud-learning.language: An English route is available. Check language on your chosen learning activity.
aws-educate-free-cloud-learning.device: Online lessons and cloud labs. A computer is practical for navigating the AWS console.
aws-educate-free-cloud-learning.assessmentFee: AWS Educate courses and hands-on labs are free. Professional AWS Certification exams are separate.
aws-educate-free-cloud-learning.award: Selected AWS Educate activities award shareable digital badges.

cisco-networking-academy-free-courses.language: Choose the language on the individual Cisco course. English options are available.
cisco-networking-academy-free-courses.device: A web browser for lessons. Check lab software requirements before choosing a networking course.
cisco-networking-academy-free-courses.assessmentFee: Choose a free self-paced course. A separate professional certification exam may carry a fee.
cisco-networking-academy-free-courses.award: Check the course for an eligible digital badge or completion award.

hubspot-academy-free-certifications.language: English courses are available. Check each course for translations.
hubspot-academy-free-certifications.device: A browser and Academy account. Some software exercises also require access to specific HubSpot tools.
hubspot-academy-free-certifications.assessmentFee: Free certification courses are available. Some practical exercises require a paid software subscription.
hubspot-academy-free-certifications.award: Certification after passing the required exam and any practical exercises for the chosen course.

forage-free-job-simulations.language: English simulations are available. Select an employer programme to check its materials.
forage-free-job-simulations.device: Use a browser. A computer is practical for tasks involving spreadsheets or document uploads.
forage-free-job-simulations.assessmentFee: R0 for the simulation and its tasks. Compare your work with the employer’s model answers.
forage-free-job-simulations.award: A completion certificate for the finished job simulation.

fao-elearning-free-courses.language: Multiple languages. The availability of each translation is shown on the course page.
fao-elearning-free-courses.device: Online courses use a browser. Check the course description for a downloadable version.
fao-elearning-free-courses.assessmentFee: The Academy offers free courses. Look for the digital badge symbol to find an assessed option.
fao-elearning-free-courses.award: A digital badge on certified courses after scoring at least 75% on the final evaluation.

disasterready-core-humanitarian-certific.device: Online learning portal. The mobile app also offers downloadable learning materials.
disasterready-core-humanitarian-certific.assessmentFee: R0 for the certification test and the optional preparation materials.
disasterready-core-humanitarian-certific.award: Core Humanitarian Certification after passing the assessment.

nwu-ai-academic-career-success.language: NWU publishes the course information in English. Other teaching languages are unspecified.
nwu-ai-academic-career-success.device: Internet access for the self-paced course and for creating your career plan.
nwu-ai-academic-career-success.assessmentFee: NWU lists the course as free and gives no separate assessment charge.
nwu-ai-academic-career-success.award: An NWU AI certificate after successful completion.

digify-pro-foundations.language: The programme guide is in English. Confirm teaching languages when applying.
digify-pro-foundations.device: Digify supports laptop, tablet and cellphone access.
digify-pro-foundations.assessmentFee: Foundations is free. Digify lists no separate assessment fee for this phase.
digify-pro-foundations.award: The programme page describes certification for later specialisations and gives no specific Foundations award.

yes-microsoft-ai-skills-vouchers.language: The YES portal is in English. Check the selected Microsoft course and exam languages.
yes-microsoft-ai-skills-vouchers.device: Browser and Microsoft Learn profile. The claim form needs a screenshot of the practice result.
yes-microsoft-ai-skills-vouchers.assessmentFee: Free learning and practice. A funded exam requires a qualifying voucher application and available allocation.
yes-microsoft-ai-skills-vouchers.award: A voucher funds an exam attempt. Microsoft certification requires passing the relevant exam.

freecodecamp-free-coding.language: English curriculum available. Translations vary by track.
freecodecamp-free-coding.device: A computer with a keyboard and browser is practical for writing code and submitting projects.
freecodecamp-free-coding.assessmentFee: R0 for the curriculum, required projects and certifications.
freecodecamp-free-coding.award: A freeCodeCamp certification after completing the requirements for your track.

unicef-agora-free-learning.language: Use the catalogue language filter to find the versions of each activity.
unicef-agora-free-learning.device: A connected computer, tablet or phone. Check for any requirements on the activity page.
unicef-agora-free-learning.assessmentFee: A public account is free. Check the chosen activity for its assessment conditions.
unicef-agora-free-learning.award: A certificate or digital badge where the activity offers one.

nibs-free-foundation-courses.language: The course descriptions are in English. Check the campus lesson for other language options.
nibs-free-foundation-courses.device: Study online on any device. Digital Literacy practical tasks require time on a computer.
nibs-free-foundation-courses.assessmentFee: R0 for the two free foundation courses, including their required tasks.
nibs-free-foundation-courses.award: NIBS Certificate of Completion recorded on your Skills Passport.

play-sa-early-childhood-development.language: The public course guide is in English. Check your chosen course for other languages.
play-sa-early-childhood-development.device: An internet-connected device that can play videos and open the course activities.
play-sa-early-childhood-development.assessmentFee: R0. Tasks and evaluations are part of the free training.
play-sa-early-childhood-development.award: Completion certificate. PLAY lists 15 SACE continuing professional development credits for the training.

xero-level-1-associate-certification.language: English on the linked self-paced course.
xero-level-1-associate-certification.device: A browser and Xero login. A laptop or desktop is practical for the bookkeeping exercises.
xero-level-1-associate-certification.assessmentFee: R0 for Xero certification, including the Level 1 assessment.
xero-level-1-associate-certification.award: Xero digital badge and downloadable certificate after passing. Valid for 12 months.

mastering-whatsapp-isixhosa.device: Android phone to follow the demonstrations, an internet connection and email for the sign-in link.
mastering-whatsapp-isixhosa.assessmentFee: The ten lessons are free. The provider lists no separate assessment.
mastering-whatsapp-isixhosa.award: The provider lists practical lessons and gives no certificate details for this course.
